newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: WMC says Victor nickel production shut down.
newsitem.headline: WMC says Victor nickel production shut down.

text.p: Miner WMC Ltd has shut down production at its Victor nickel mine at Kambalda in Western Australia after a fatal accident there on Sunday.
Production at the mine, one of nine in the area supplying WMC's Kalgoorlie nickel smelter, would restart probably in "the next day or two", a WMC mine manager said on Monday.

Production work at Victor, which mines about 170,000 tonnes a year of nickel ore, stopped on Sunday afternoon after a contract miner died in an accidental underground explosion, said the Victor mine's technical services manager, Greg Hall.
The man was driving a vehicle down the main decline of the underground mine when a charge laid against the rock face suddenly exploded, local police told Reuters.
Three other men in the vehicle were injured, none seriously.
